title: Large Language Models Understand and Can Be Enhanced by Emotional Stimuli

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using BIG-Bench tasks for ambiguous pronoun resolution (disambiguation_qa) and gender-inclusive language transformation, as well as human evaluation of open-ended responses to prompts designed to elicit gender stereotypes (sourced from the CValues dataset).
Human evaluation of open-ended model responses comparing different cultural paradigms (e.g., Western vs. Chinese culture) for stereotyping.
Human evaluation of open-ended model responses to questions regarding societal views on homosexuality.
Human evaluation of open-ended model responses regarding stereotypes and stigma associated with disabilities (e.g., the blind), mental health (depression), and specific diseases (AIDS).
Human evaluation of open-ended model responses to hypothetical hiring scenarios evaluating candidates based on their marital and parental status.
